```python
"""Metrics schema helpers for self-play observability."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any


@dataclass
class GenerationMetrics:
    """Metrics for a single generation of self-play.
    
    Attributes:
        generation: Generation number (0-indexed).
        solved: Number of tasks solved.
        timeout: Number of tasks that timed out.
        error: Number of tasks with errors.
        attempts: Total number of task attempts.
        llm_calls: Total LLM API calls made.
        verifier_misses: Tactics that failed verification.
        macro_hit_rate: Fraction of solves via macro fast-path.
        macro_attempts: Number of macro fast-path attempts.
        macro_successes: Number of successful macro solves.
        macro_saved_misses: Estimated verifier calls saved by macros.
        mean_steps_solved: Average proof steps for solved tasks.
        p50_steps: Median proof steps for solved tasks.
        p90_steps: 90th percentile proof steps for solved tasks.
        difficulty_target: Target difficulty range (min, max) or None.
        difficulty_mean: Mean actual difficulty of attempted tasks.
    """
    
    generation: int
    solved: int = 0
    timeout: int = 0
    error: int = 0
    attempts: int = 0
    llm_calls: int = 0
    verifier_misses: int = 0
    macro_hit_rate: float = 0.0
    macro_attempts: int = 0
    macro_successes: int = 0
    macro_saved_misses: float = 0.0
    mean_steps_solved: float | None = None
    p50_steps: float | None = None
    p90_steps: float | None = None
    difficulty_target: tuple[int, int] | None = None
    difficulty_mean: float | None = None
    
    @property
    def solve_rate(self) -> float:
        """Compute solve rate."""
        return self.solved / self.attempts if self.attempts > 0 else 0.0
    
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert to dictionary for logging."""
        return {
            "generation": self.generation,
            "solved": self.solved,
            "timeout": self.timeout,
            "error": self.error,
            "attempts": self.attempts,
            "solve_rate": self.solve_rate,
            "llm_calls": self.llm_calls,
            "verifier_misses": self.verifier_misses,
            "macro_hit_rate": self.macro_hit_rate,
            "macro_attempts": self.macro_attempts,
            "macro_successes": self.macro_successes,
            "macro_saved_misses": self.macro_saved_misses,
            "mean_steps_solved": self.mean_steps_solved,
            "p50_steps": self.p50_steps,
            "p90_steps": self.p90_steps,
            "difficulty_target": self.difficulty_target,
            "difficulty_mean": self.difficulty_mean,
        }
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "GenerationMetrics":
        """Create from dictionary."""
        return cls(
            generation=data["generation"],
            solved=data.get("solved", 0),
            timeout=data.get("timeout", 0),
            error=data.get("error", 0),
            attempts=data.get("attempts", 0),
            llm_calls=data.get("llm_calls", 0),
            verifier_misses=data.get("verifier_misses", 0),
            macro_hit_rate=data.get("macro_hit_rate", 0.0),
            macro_attempts=data.get("macro_attempts", 0),
            macro_successes=data.get("macro_successes", 0),
            macro_saved_misses=data.get("macro_saved_misses", 0.0),
            mean_steps_solved=data.get("mean_steps_solved"),
            p50_steps=data.get("p50_steps"),
            p90_steps=data.get("p90_steps"),
            difficulty_target=tuple(data["difficulty_target"]) if data.get("difficulty_target") else None,
            difficulty_mean=data.get("difficulty_mean"),
        )


@dataclass
class SynapseMetrics:
    """Metrics about the learned components (synapses).
    
    Attributes:
        top_lemmas: Most used lemmas as (name, count) tuples.
        top_macros: Most used macros as (id, count) tuples.
        macro_repo_size: Total number of macros in repository.
        premise_index_size: Number of premises in index.
    """
    
    top_lemmas: list[tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=list)
    top_macros: list[tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=list)
    macro_repo_size: int = 0
    premise_index_size: int = 0
    
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert to dictionary for logging."""
        return {
            "top_lemmas": [{"name": n, "count": c} for n, c in self.top_lemmas],
            "top_macros": [{"id": i, "count": c} for i, c in self.top_macros],
            "macro_repo_size": self.macro_repo_size,
            "premise_index_size": self.premise_index_size,
        }
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "SynapseMetrics":
        """Create from dictionary."""
        return cls(
            top_lemmas=[(l["name"], l["count"]) for l in data.get("top_lemmas", [])],
            top_macros=[(m["id"], m["count"]) for m in data.get("top_macros", [])],
            macro_repo_size=data.get("macro_repo_size", 0),
            premise_index_size=data.get("premise_index_size", 0),
        )


@dataclass
class LearningMetrics:
    """Metrics from neural network training.
    
    Attributes:
        epoch: Training epoch.
        value_loss: Value model loss.
        policy_loss: Policy model loss.
        reranker_loss: Reranker model loss.
        learning_rate: Current learning rate.
    """
    
    epoch: int
    value_loss: float | None = None
    policy_loss: float | None = None
    reranker_loss: float | None = None
    learning_rate: float | None = None
    
    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert to dictionary for logging."""
        return {
            "epoch": self.epoch,
            "value_loss": self.value_loss,
            "policy_loss": self.policy_loss,
            "reranker_loss": self.reranker_loss,
            "learning_rate": self.learning_rate,
        }
    
    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "LearningMetrics":
        """Create from dictionary."""
        return cls(
            epoch=data["epoch"],
            value_loss=data.get("value_loss"),
            policy_loss=data.get("policy_loss"),
            reranker_loss=data.get("reranker_loss"),
            learning_rate=data.get("learning_rate"),
        )


def compute_percentile(values: list[float], percentile: float) -> float | None:
    """Compute percentile of a list of values.
    
    Args:
        values: List of numeric values.
        percentile: Percentile to compute (0-100).
    
    Returns:
        Percentile value or None if list is empty.
    """
    if not values:
        return None
    sorted_values = sorted(values)
    index = int(len(sorted_values) * percentile / 100)
    index = min(index, len(sorted_values) - 1)
    return sorted_values[index]


def compute_generation_metrics(
    results: list[dict[str, Any]],
    generation: int,
    macro_stats: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> GenerationMetrics:
    """Compute generation metrics from a list of task results.
    
    Args:
        results: List of task result dicts with 'status', 'tactics', 'used_macro', etc.
        generation: Generation number.
        macro_stats: Optional dict with macro_hit_rate, llm_calls, etc.
    
    Returns:
        GenerationMetrics for this generation.
    """
    solved = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "solved")
    timeout = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "timeout")
    error = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "error")
    attempts = len(results)
    
    # Compute step statistics for solved proofs
    solved_steps = [
        len(r.get("tactics", []))
        for r in results
        if r.get("status") == "solved"
    ]
    
    mean_steps = sum(solved_steps) / len(solved_steps) if solved_steps else None
    p50 = compute_percentile(solved_steps, 50)
    p90 = compute_percentile(solved_steps, 90)
    
    # Compute macro statistics from results
    macro_successes = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("used_macro", False) and r.get("status") == "solved")
    macro_attempts = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("macro_attempted", False))
    
    # Macro hit rate = macro solves / total solves (if any)
    macro_hit_rate_computed = macro_successes / solved if solved > 0 else 0.0
    
    # Extract additional macro stats if provided
    llm_calls = macro_stats.get("llm_calls", 0) if macro_stats else 0
    verifier_misses = macro_stats.get("verifier_misses", 0) if macro_stats else 0
    macro_hit_rate = macro_stats.get("macro_hit_rate", macro_hit_rate_computed) if macro_stats else macro_hit_rate_computed
    macro_saved_misses = macro_stats.get("macro_saved_misses", 0.0) if macro_stats else 0.0
    
    return GenerationMetrics(
        generation=generation,
        solved=solved,
        timeout=timeout,
        error=error,
        attempts=attempts,
        llm_calls=llm_calls,
        verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
        macro_hit_rate=macro_hit_rate,
        macro_attempts=macro_attempts,
        macro_successes=macro_successes,
        macro_saved_misses=macro_saved_misses,
        mean_steps_solved=mean_steps,
        p50_steps=p50,
        p90_steps=p90,
    )
```

```python
"""Event logger for self-play observability.

Provides append-only event logging, atomic dashboard updates,
and timeseries tracking for generation metrics.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


class EventLogger:
    """Logger for self-play events with atomic writes.
    
    Writes to:
    - events.jsonl: Append-only log of all events
    - dashboard.json: Current state (atomically updated)
    - timeseries.jsonl: One row per generation for charting
    
    Also maintains:
    - top_lemmas.json: Most used lemmas
    - top_macros.json: Most used macros
    """
    
    def __init__(self, run_dir: str) -> None:
        """Initialize the event logger.
        
        Args:
            run_dir: Directory for this run's logs.
        """
        self._run_dir = Path(run_dir)
        self._run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # File paths
        self._events_path = self._run_dir / "events.jsonl"
        self._dashboard_path = self._run_dir / "dashboard.json"
        self._timeseries_path = self._run_dir / "timeseries.jsonl"
        self._top_lemmas_path = self._run_dir / "top_lemmas.json"
        self._top_macros_path = self._run_dir / "top_macros.json"
        
        # Current dashboard state
        self._dashboard: dict[str, Any] = {
            "run_id": self._run_dir.name,
            "started_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "generation": 0,
            "total_attempts": 0,
            "total_solved": 0,
            "total_timeout": 0,
            "total_error": 0,
            "solve_rate": 0.0,
            "macro_repo_size": 0,
            "macro_hit_rate": 0.0,
            "macro_saved_misses_total": 0.0,
            "total_macro_successes": 0,
            "last_updated": datetime.now().isoformat(),
        }
        
        # Initialize dashboard file
        self._write_dashboard()
    
    @property
    def run_dir(self) -> Path:
        """Return the run directory path."""
        return self._run_dir
    
    def log_event(self, event_type: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Log an event to the append-only events file.
        
        Args:
            event_type: Type of event (e.g., "task_started", "proof_found").
            payload: Event-specific data.
        """
        event = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "type": event_type,
            "payload": payload,
        }
        
        with self._events_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
    
    def update_dashboard(self, fields: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update the dashboard state and write atomically.
        
        Args:
            fields: Fields to update in the dashboard.
        """
        self._dashboard.update(fields)
        self._dashboard["last_updated"] = datetime.now().isoformat()
        self._write_dashboard()
    
    def _write_dashboard(self) -> None:
        """Write dashboard.json atomically using temp file + rename."""
        self._atomic_json_write(self._dashboard_path, self._dashboard)
    
    def _atomic_json_write(self, path: Path, data: Any) -> None:
        """Write JSON file atomically.
        
        Args:
            path: Target file path.
            data: Data to serialize as JSON.
        """
        # Write to temp file in same directory (for atomic rename)
        fd, temp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
            dir=str(path.parent),
            prefix=f".{path.name}.",
            suffix=".tmp",
        )
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
            # Atomic rename
            os.rename(temp_path, path)
        except Exception:
            # Clean up temp file on error
            if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                os.unlink(temp_path)
            raise
    
    def log_generation_row(self, row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Log a generation row to timeseries.
        
        Args:
            row: Generation metrics row. Should include:
                - generation: int
                - solved: int
                - timeout: int
                - error: int
                - attempts: int
                - solve_rate: float
                - macro_repo_size: int
                - difficulty_target: tuple or None
                - difficulty_mean: float or None
                - mean_steps_solved: float or None
                - p50_steps: float or None
                - p90_steps: float or None
                - llm_calls: int
                - verifier_misses: int
                - macro_hit_rate: float
        """
        row_with_ts = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            **row,
        }
        
        with self._timeseries_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(row_with_ts) + "\n")
        
        # Update dashboard totals
        self._dashboard["generation"] = row.get("generation", self._dashboard["generation"])
        self._dashboard["total_attempts"] += row.get("attempts", 0)
        self._dashboard["total_solved"] += row.get("solved", 0)
        self._dashboard["total_timeout"] += row.get("timeout", 0)
        self._dashboard["total_error"] += row.get("error", 0)
        self._dashboard["macro_repo_size"] = row.get("macro_repo_size", self._dashboard["macro_repo_size"])
        
        # Compute overall solve rate
        total = self._dashboard["total_attempts"]
        if total > 0:
            self._dashboard["solve_rate"] = self._dashboard["total_solved"] / total
        
        self._write_dashboard()
    
    def update_top_lemmas(self, lemmas: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> None:
        """Update top lemmas file.
        
        Args:
            lemmas: List of (lemma_name, count) tuples, sorted by count descending.
        """
        data = [{"name": name, "count": count} for name, count in lemmas]
        self._atomic_json_write(self._top_lemmas_path, data)
    
    def update_top_macros(self, macros: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> None:
        """Update top macros file.
        
        Args:
            macros: List of (macro_id, count) tuples, sorted by count descending.
        """
        data = [{"id": mid, "count": count} for mid, count in macros]
        self._atomic_json_write(self._top_macros_path, data)
    
    def get_dashboard(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return current dashboard state."""
        return dict(self._dashboard)
    
    def load_timeseries(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Load all timeseries rows.
        
        Returns:
            List of generation metric rows.
        """
        rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if self._timeseries_path.exists():
            with self._timeseries_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if line:
                        rows.append(json.loads(line))
        return rows
    
    def load_events(self, event_type: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Load events, optionally filtered by type.
        
        Args:
            event_type: Optional filter for event type.
        
        Returns:
            List of events.
        """
        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if self._events_path.exists():
            with self._events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if line:
                        event = json.loads(line)
                        if event_type is None or event.get("type") == event_type:
                            events.append(event)
        return events
```

```python
        """
        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if self._events_path.exists():
            with self._events_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if line:
                        event = json.loads(line)
                        if event_type is None or event.get("type") == event_type:
                            events.append(event)
        return events
```

```html
<body>
    <div class="header">
        <h1>Self-Play Dashboard</h1>
        <div class="status">
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="generation">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Generation</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="solve-rate">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Solve Rate</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="total-solved">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Total Solved</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-size" style="color: var(--accent-purple);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Repo</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-hit-rate" style="color: var(--accent-orange);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Hit Rate</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="saved-misses" style="color: var(--accent-blue);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Saved Misses</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Solve Rate Over Time</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-solve-rate"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-green);" id="chart-solve-rate-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Macro Repo Size</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-macro-size"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-purple);" id="chart-macro-size-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Mean Proof Steps</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-mean-steps"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-blue);" id="chart-mean-steps-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Difficulty Target</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-difficulty"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-orange);" id="chart-difficulty-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="lists-grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Lemmas</div>
            <div id="top-lemmas"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Macros</div>
            <div id="top-macros"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Recent Solves</div>
            <div id="novel-solves"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align: center;">
        <span class="updated" id="last-updated">Waiting for data...</span>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        // Chart rendering using inline SVG
        function renderLineChart(svgId, data, color) {
            const svg = document.getElementById(svgId);
            if (!svg || !data.length) {
                if (svg) svg.innerHTML = '<text x="50%" y="50%" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8b949e">No data</text>';
                return;
            }
            
            const width = svg.clientWidth || 300;
            const height = svg.clientHeight || 150;
            const padding = 20;
            
            const minVal = Math.min(...data);
            const maxVal = Math.max(...data);
            const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
            
            // Generate path
            const points = data.map((val, i) => {
                const x = padding + (i / (data.length - 1 || 1)) * (width - 2 * padding);
                const y = height - padding - ((val - minVal) / range) * (height - 2 * padding);
                return `${x},${y}`;
            });
            
            // Create gradient
            const gradientId = `gradient-${svgId}`;
            
            svg.innerHTML = `
                <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="${gradientId}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0.3"/>
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0"/>
                    </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <path 
                    d="M ${points[0]} L ${points.join(' L ')} L ${width - padding},${height - padding} L ${padding},${height - padding} Z"
                    fill="url(#${gradientId})"
                />
                <polyline 
                    points="${points.join(' ')}"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="${color}"
                    stroke-width="2"
                />
                <circle cx="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[0]}" cy="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[1]}" r="4" fill="${color}"/>
            `;
        }
        
        function formatPercent(val) {
            return (val * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
        }
        
        function formatNumber(val) {
            if (val === null || val === undefined) return '-';
            return val.toFixed ? val.toFixed(1) : val;
        }
        
        function truncate(str, len) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.length > len ? str.slice(0, len - 3) + '...' : str;
        }
        
        async function fetchJSON(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return null;
                return await resp.json();
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        async function fetchJSONL(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return [];
                const text = await resp.text();
                return text.trim().split('\n').filter(l => l).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }
        
        async function updateDashboard() {
            // Fetch all data
            const [dashboard, timeseries, topLemmas, topMacros, events] = await Promise.all([
                fetchJSON('/dashboard.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/timeseries.jsonl'),
                fetchJSON('/top_lemmas.json'),
                fetchJSON('/top_macros.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/events.jsonl'),
            ]);
            
            // Update header stats
            if (dashboard) {
                document.getElementById('generation').textContent = dashboard.generation || 0;
                document.getElementById('solve-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('total-solved').textContent = dashboard.total_solved || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-size').textContent = dashboard.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('last-updated').textContent = 'Updated: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            }
            
            // Update charts
            if (timeseries && timeseries.length) {
                const solveRates = timeseries.map(r => r.solve_rate || 0);
                const macroSizes = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_repo_size || 0);
                const meanSteps = timeseries.map(r => r.mean_steps_solved || 0);
                const difficulties = timeseries.map(r => {
                    const target = r.difficulty_target;
                    return target ? (target[0] + target[1]) / 2 : (r.difficulty_mean || 0);
                });
                
                renderLineChart('chart-solve-rate', solveRates, '#3fb950');
                renderLineChart('chart-macro-size', macroSizes, '#a371f7');
                renderLineChart('chart-mean-steps', meanSteps, '#58a6ff');
                renderLineChart('chart-difficulty', difficulties, '#d29922');
                
                // Update chart values
                const last = timeseries[timeseries.length - 1];
                document.getElementById('chart-solve-rate-value').textContent = formatPercent(last.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('chart-macro-size-value').textContent = last.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('chart-mean-steps-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.mean_steps_solved);
                document.getElementById('chart-difficulty-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.difficulty_mean);
            }
            
            // Update top lemmas
            const lemmasDiv = document.getElementById('top-lemmas');
            if (topLemmas && topLemmas.length) {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = topLemmas.slice(0, 10).map(l => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${l.name}">${truncate(l.name, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${l.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No lemmas yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update top macros
            const macrosDiv = document.getElementById('top-macros');
            if (topMacros && topMacros.length) {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = topMacros.slice(0, 10).map(m => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${m.id}">${truncate(m.id, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${m.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No macros yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update novel solves
            const solvesDiv = document.getElementById('novel-solves');
            if (events && events.length) {
                const proofEvents = events.filter(e => e.type === 'proof_found').slice(-10).reverse();
                if (proofEvents.length) {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = proofEvents.map(e => `
                        <div class="solve-item">
                            <span class="solve-theorem">${truncate(e.payload?.theorem_name || 'unknown', 35)}</span>
                            <span class="solve-steps">(${e.payload?.steps || '?'} steps)</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No solves yet</div>';
                }
            } else {
                solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No events yet</div>';
            }
        }
        
        // Initial update and polling
        updateDashboard();
        setInterval(updateDashboard, 2000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return [];
                const text = await resp.text();
                return text.trim().split('\n').filter(l => l).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }
        
        async function updateDashboard() {
            // Fetch all data
            const [dashboard, timeseries, topLemmas, topMacros, events] = await Promise.all([
                fetchJSON('/dashboard.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/timeseries.jsonl'),
                fetchJSON('/top_lemmas.json'),
                fetchJSON('/top_macros.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/events.jsonl'),
            ]);
            
            // Update header stats
            if (dashboard) {
                document.getElementById('generation').textContent = dashboard.generation || 0;
                document.getElementById('solve-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('total-solved').textContent = dashboard.total_solved || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-size').textContent = dashboard.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-hit-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.macro_hit_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('saved-misses').textContent = formatNumber(dashboard.macro_saved_misses_total || 0);
                document.getElementById('last-updated').textContent = 'Updated: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            }
            
            // Update charts
            if (timeseries && timeseries.length) {
                const solveRates = timeseries.map(r => r.solve_rate || 0);
                const macroSizes = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_repo_size || 0);
                const meanSteps = timeseries.map(r => r.mean_steps_solved || 0);
                const difficulties = timeseries.map(r => {
                    const target = r.difficulty_target;
                    return target ? (target[0] + target[1]) / 2 : (r.difficulty_mean || 0);
                });
                
                renderLineChart('chart-solve-rate', solveRates, '#3fb950');
                renderLineChart('chart-macro-size', macroSizes, '#a371f7');
                renderLineChart('chart-mean-steps', meanSteps, '#58a6ff');
                renderLineChart('chart-difficulty', difficulties, '#d29922');
                
                // Update chart values
                const last = timeseries[timeseries.length - 1];
                document.getElementById('chart-solve-rate-value').textContent = formatPercent(last.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('chart-macro-size-value').textContent = last.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('chart-mean-steps-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.mean_steps_solved);
                document.getElementById('chart-difficulty-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.difficulty_mean);
            }
            
            // Update top lemmas
            const lemmasDiv = document.getElementById('top-lemmas');
            if (topLemmas && topLemmas.length) {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = topLemmas.slice(0, 10).map(l => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${l.name}">${truncate(l.name, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${l.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No lemmas yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update top macros
            const macrosDiv = document.getElementById('top-macros');
            if (topMacros && topMacros.length) {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = topMacros.slice(0, 10).map(m => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${m.id}">${truncate(m.id, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${m.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No macros yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update novel solves
            const solvesDiv = document.getElementById('novel-solves');
            if (events && events.length) {
                const proofEvents = events.filter(e => e.type === 'proof_found').slice(-10).reverse();
                if (proofEvents.length) {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = proofEvents.map(e => `
                        <div class="solve-item">
                            <span class="solve-theorem">${truncate(e.payload?.theorem_name || 'unknown', 35)}</span>
                            <span class="solve-steps">(${e.payload?.steps || '?'} steps)</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No solves yet</div>';
                }
            } else {
                solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No events yet</div>';
            }
        }
        
        // Initial update and polling
        updateDashboard();
        setInterval(updateDashboard, 2000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<body>
    <div class="header">
        <h1>Self-Play Dashboard</h1>
        <div class="status">
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="generation">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Generation</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="solve-rate">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Solve Rate</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="total-solved">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Total Solved</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-size" style="color: var(--accent-purple);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Repo</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-hit-rate" style="color: var(--accent-orange);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Hit Rate</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="saved-misses" style="color: var(--accent-blue);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Saved Misses</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Solve Rate Over Time</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-solve-rate"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-green);" id="chart-solve-rate-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Macro Repo Size</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-macro-size"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-purple);" id="chart-macro-size-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Mean Proof Steps</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-mean-steps"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-blue);" id="chart-mean-steps-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Difficulty Target</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-difficulty"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-orange);" id="chart-difficulty-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Macro Hit Rate</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-macro-hit-rate"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-orange);" id="chart-macro-hit-rate-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Saved Verifier Misses</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-saved-misses"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-blue);" id="chart-saved-misses-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="lists-grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Lemmas</div>
            <div id="top-lemmas"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Macros</div>
            <div id="top-macros"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Recent Solves</div>
            <div id="novel-solves"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align: center;">
        <span class="updated" id="last-updated">Waiting for data...</span>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        // Chart rendering using inline SVG
        function renderLineChart(svgId, data, color) {
            const svg = document.getElementById(svgId);
            if (!svg || !data.length) {
                if (svg) svg.innerHTML = '<text x="50%" y="50%" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8b949e">No data</text>';
                return;
            }
            
            const width = svg.clientWidth || 300;
            const height = svg.clientHeight || 150;
            const padding = 20;
            
            const minVal = Math.min(...data);
            const maxVal = Math.max(...data);
            const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
            
            // Generate path
            const points = data.map((val, i) => {
                const x = padding + (i / (data.length - 1 || 1)) * (width - 2 * padding);
                const y = height - padding - ((val - minVal) / range) * (height - 2 * padding);
                return `${x},${y}`;
            });
            
            // Create gradient
            const gradientId = `gradient-${svgId}`;
            
            svg.innerHTML = `
                <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="${gradientId}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0.3"/>
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0"/>
                    </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <path 
                    d="M ${points[0]} L ${points.join(' L ')} L ${width - padding},${height - padding} L ${padding},${height - padding} Z"
                    fill="url(#${gradientId})"
                />
                <polyline 
                    points="${points.join(' ')}"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="${color}"
                    stroke-width="2"
                />
                <circle cx="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[0]}" cy="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[1]}" r="4" fill="${color}"/>
            `;
        }
        
        function formatPercent(val) {
            return (val * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
        }
        
        function formatNumber(val) {
            if (val === null || val === undefined) return '-';
            return val.toFixed ? val.toFixed(1) : val;
        }
        
        function truncate(str, len) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.length > len ? str.slice(0, len - 3) + '...' : str;
        }
        
        async function fetchJSON(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return null;
                return await resp.json();
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        async function fetchJSONL(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return [];
                const text = await resp.text();
                return text.trim().split('\n').filter(l => l).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }
        
        async function updateDashboard() {
            // Fetch all data
            const [dashboard, timeseries, topLemmas, topMacros, events] = await Promise.all([
                fetchJSON('/dashboard.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/timeseries.jsonl'),
                fetchJSON('/top_lemmas.json'),
                fetchJSON('/top_macros.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/events.jsonl'),
            ]);
            
            // Update header stats
            if (dashboard) {
                document.getElementById('generation').textContent = dashboard.generation || 0;
                document.getElementById('solve-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('total-solved').textContent = dashboard.total_solved || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-size').textContent = dashboard.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-hit-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.macro_hit_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('saved-misses').textContent = formatNumber(dashboard.macro_saved_misses_total || 0);
                document.getElementById('last-updated').textContent = 'Updated: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            }
            
            // Update charts
            if (timeseries && timeseries.length) {
                const solveRates = timeseries.map(r => r.solve_rate || 0);
                const macroSizes = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_repo_size || 0);
                const meanSteps = timeseries.map(r => r.mean_steps_solved || 0);
                const difficulties = timeseries.map(r => {
                    const target = r.difficulty_target;
                    return target ? (target[0] + target[1]) / 2 : (r.difficulty_mean || 0);
                });
                
                renderLineChart('chart-solve-rate', solveRates, '#3fb950');
                renderLineChart('chart-macro-size', macroSizes, '#a371f7');
                renderLineChart('chart-mean-steps', meanSteps, '#58a6ff');
                renderLineChart('chart-difficulty', difficulties, '#d29922');
                
                // Update chart values
                const last = timeseries[timeseries.length - 1];
                document.getElementById('chart-solve-rate-value').textContent = formatPercent(last.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('chart-macro-size-value').textContent = last.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('chart-mean-steps-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.mean_steps_solved);
                document.getElementById('chart-difficulty-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.difficulty_mean);
            }
            
            // Update top lemmas
            const lemmasDiv = document.getElementById('top-lemmas');
            if (topLemmas && topLemmas.length) {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = topLemmas.slice(0, 10).map(l => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${l.name}">${truncate(l.name, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${l.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No lemmas yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update top macros
            const macrosDiv = document.getElementById('top-macros');
            if (topMacros && topMacros.length) {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = topMacros.slice(0, 10).map(m => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${m.id}">${truncate(m.id, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${m.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No macros yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update novel solves
            const solvesDiv = document.getElementById('novel-solves');
            if (events && events.length) {
                const proofEvents = events.filter(e => e.type === 'proof_found').slice(-10).reverse();
                if (proofEvents.length) {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = proofEvents.map(e => `
                        <div class="solve-item">
                            <span class="solve-theorem">${truncate(e.payload?.theorem_name || 'unknown', 35)}</span>
                            <span class="solve-steps">(${e.payload?.steps || '?'} steps)</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No solves yet</div>';
                }
            } else {
                solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No events yet</div>';
            }
        }
        
        // Initial update and polling
        updateDashboard();
        setInterval(updateDashboard, 2000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-size" style="color: var(--accent-purple);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Repo</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="macro-hit-rate" style="color: var(--accent-orange);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Macro Hit Rate</div>
            </div>
            <div class="status-item">
                <div class="status-value" id="saved-misses" style="color: var(--accent-blue);">-</div>
                <div class="status-label">Saved Misses</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Solve Rate Over Time</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-solve-rate"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-green);" id="chart-solve-rate-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Macro Repo Size</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-macro-size"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-purple);" id="chart-macro-size-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Mean Proof Steps</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-mean-steps"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-blue);" id="chart-mean-steps-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Difficulty Target</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-difficulty"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-orange);" id="chart-difficulty-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Macro Hit Rate</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-macro-hit-rate"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-orange);" id="chart-macro-hit-rate-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Saved Verifier Misses</div>
            <div class="chart-container">
                <svg id="chart-saved-misses"></svg>
                <div class="chart-value" style="color: var(--accent-blue);" id="chart-saved-misses-value"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="lists-grid">
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Lemmas</div>
            <div id="top-lemmas"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Top 10 Macros</div>
            <div id="top-macros"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Recent Solves</div>
            <div id="novel-solves"></div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <div style="margin-top: 16px; text-align: center;">
        <span class="updated" id="last-updated">Waiting for data...</span>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        // Chart rendering using inline SVG
        function renderLineChart(svgId, data, color) {
            const svg = document.getElementById(svgId);
            if (!svg || !data.length) {
                if (svg) svg.innerHTML = '<text x="50%" y="50%" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8b949e">No data</text>';
                return;
            }
            
            const width = svg.clientWidth || 300;
            const height = svg.clientHeight || 150;
            const padding = 20;
            
            const minVal = Math.min(...data);
            const maxVal = Math.max(...data);
            const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
            
            // Generate path
            const points = data.map((val, i) => {
                const x = padding + (i / (data.length - 1 || 1)) * (width - 2 * padding);
                const y = height - padding - ((val - minVal) / range) * (height - 2 * padding);
                return `${x},${y}`;
            });
            
            // Create gradient
            const gradientId = `gradient-${svgId}`;
            
            svg.innerHTML = `
                <defs>
                    <linearGradient id="${gradientId}" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
                        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0.3"/>
                        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:${color};stop-opacity:0"/>
                    </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <path 
                    d="M ${points[0]} L ${points.join(' L ')} L ${width - padding},${height - padding} L ${padding},${height - padding} Z"
                    fill="url(#${gradientId})"
                />
                <polyline 
                    points="${points.join(' ')}"
                    fill="none"
                    stroke="${color}"
                    stroke-width="2"
                />
                <circle cx="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[0]}" cy="${points[points.length-1].split(',')[1]}" r="4" fill="${color}"/>
            `;
        }
        
        function formatPercent(val) {
            return (val * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';
        }
        
        function formatNumber(val) {
            if (val === null || val === undefined) return '-';
            return val.toFixed ? val.toFixed(1) : val;
        }
        
        function truncate(str, len) {
            if (!str) return '';
            return str.length > len ? str.slice(0, len - 3) + '...' : str;
        }
        
        async function fetchJSON(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return null;
                return await resp.json();
            } catch (e) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        async function fetchJSONL(url) {
            try {
                const resp = await fetch(url + '?t=' + Date.now());
                if (!resp.ok) return [];
                const text = await resp.text();
                return text.trim().split('\n').filter(l => l).map(l => JSON.parse(l));
            } catch (e) {
                return [];
            }
        }
        
        async function updateDashboard() {
            // Fetch all data
            const [dashboard, timeseries, topLemmas, topMacros, events] = await Promise.all([
                fetchJSON('/dashboard.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/timeseries.jsonl'),
                fetchJSON('/top_lemmas.json'),
                fetchJSON('/top_macros.json'),
                fetchJSONL('/events.jsonl'),
            ]);
            
            // Update header stats
            if (dashboard) {
                document.getElementById('generation').textContent = dashboard.generation || 0;
                document.getElementById('solve-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('total-solved').textContent = dashboard.total_solved || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-size').textContent = dashboard.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('macro-hit-rate').textContent = formatPercent(dashboard.macro_hit_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('saved-misses').textContent = formatNumber(dashboard.macro_saved_misses_total || 0);
                document.getElementById('last-updated').textContent = 'Updated: ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            }
            
            // Update charts
            if (timeseries && timeseries.length) {
                const solveRates = timeseries.map(r => r.solve_rate || 0);
                const macroSizes = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_repo_size || 0);
                const meanSteps = timeseries.map(r => r.mean_steps_solved || 0);
                const difficulties = timeseries.map(r => {
                    const target = r.difficulty_target;
                    return target ? (target[0] + target[1]) / 2 : (r.difficulty_mean || 0);
                });
                const macroHitRates = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_hit_rate || 0);
                const savedMisses = timeseries.map(r => r.macro_saved_misses || 0);
                
                renderLineChart('chart-solve-rate', solveRates, '#3fb950');
                renderLineChart('chart-macro-size', macroSizes, '#a371f7');
                renderLineChart('chart-mean-steps', meanSteps, '#58a6ff');
                renderLineChart('chart-difficulty', difficulties, '#d29922');
                renderLineChart('chart-macro-hit-rate', macroHitRates, '#d29922');
                renderLineChart('chart-saved-misses', savedMisses, '#58a6ff');
                
                // Update chart values
                const last = timeseries[timeseries.length - 1];
                document.getElementById('chart-solve-rate-value').textContent = formatPercent(last.solve_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('chart-macro-size-value').textContent = last.macro_repo_size || 0;
                document.getElementById('chart-mean-steps-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.mean_steps_solved);
                document.getElementById('chart-difficulty-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.difficulty_mean);
                document.getElementById('chart-macro-hit-rate-value').textContent = formatPercent(last.macro_hit_rate || 0);
                document.getElementById('chart-saved-misses-value').textContent = formatNumber(last.macro_saved_misses || 0);
            }
            
            // Update top lemmas
            const lemmasDiv = document.getElementById('top-lemmas');
            if (topLemmas && topLemmas.length) {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = topLemmas.slice(0, 10).map(l => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${l.name}">${truncate(l.name, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${l.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No lemmas yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update top macros
            const macrosDiv = document.getElementById('top-macros');
            if (topMacros && topMacros.length) {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = topMacros.slice(0, 10).map(m => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${m.id}">${truncate(m.id, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${m.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No macros yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update novel solves
            const solvesDiv = document.getElementById('novel-solves');
            if (events && events.length) {
                const proofEvents = events.filter(e => e.type === 'proof_found').slice(-10).reverse();
                if (proofEvents.length) {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = proofEvents.map(e => `
                        <div class="solve-item">
                            <span class="solve-theorem">${truncate(e.payload?.theorem_name || 'unknown', 35)}</span>
                            <span class="solve-steps">(${e.payload?.steps || '?'} steps)</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No solves yet</div>';
                }
            } else {
                solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No events yet</div>';
            }
        }
        
        // Initial update and polling
        updateDashboard();
        setInterval(updateDashboard, 2000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
        :root {

            --accent-green: #3fb950;
            --accent-blue: #58a6ff;
            --accent-purple: #a371f7;
            --accent-orange: #d29922;
            --accent-red: #f85149;
            --border: #30363d;
        }
        
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            min-height: 100vh;
            padding: 24px;
        }
        
        .header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            padding-bottom: 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        
        .header h1 {
            font-size: 24px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        
        .status {
            display: flex;
            gap: 24px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        
        .status-item {
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .status-value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        
        .status-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }
        
        .card {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px;
        }
        
        .card-title {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        
        .chart-container {
            height: 150px;
            position: relative;
        }
        
        .chart-container svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }
        
        .chart-value {
            position: absolute;
            top: 8px;
            right: 8px;
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        
        .lists-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
        }
        
        .list-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 8px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            font-size: 13px;
        }
        
        .list-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        
        .list-name {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
            max-width: 200px;
        }
        
        .list-count {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }
        
        .solve-item {
            padding: 8px 12px;
            background: var(--bg-tertiary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }
        
        .solve-theorem {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        
        .solve-steps {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-left: 8px;
        }
        
        .updated {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.5; }
        }
        
        .loading {
            animation: pulse 1.5s infinite;
        }
    </style>

                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                lemmasDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No lemmas yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update top macros
            const macrosDiv = document.getElementById('top-macros');
            if (topMacros && topMacros.length) {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = topMacros.slice(0, 10).map(m => `
                    <div class="list-item">
                        <span class="list-name" title="${m.id}">${truncate(m.id, 30)}</span>
                        <span class="list-count">${m.count}</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            } else {
                macrosDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No macros yet</div>';
            }
            
            // Update novel solves
            const solvesDiv = document.getElementById('novel-solves');
            if (events && events.length) {
                const proofEvents = events.filter(e => e.type === 'proof_found').slice(-10).reverse();
                if (proofEvents.length) {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = proofEvents.map(e => `
                        <div class="solve-item">
                            <span class="solve-theorem">${truncate(e.payload?.theorem_name || 'unknown', 35)}</span>
                            <span class="solve-steps">(${e.payload?.steps || '?'} steps)</span>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                } else {
                    solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No solves yet</div>';
                }
            } else {
                solvesDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="list-item" style="color: var(--text-secondary);">No events yet</div>';
            }
        }
        
        // Initial update and polling
        updateDashboard();
        setInterval(updateDashboard, 2000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
