```python
"""Web server for self-play dashboard with run management.

Serves static HTML and JSON files for the web-based dashboard,
plus API endpoints for managing runs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
from functools import partial
from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import parse_qs


class DashboardHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    """HTTP handler for dashboard files and API."""
    
    def __init__(self, *args, run_dir: str, assets_dir: str, runs_base_dir: str, **kwargs) -> None:
        self._run_dir = Path(run_dir)
        self._assets_dir = Path(assets_dir)
        self._runs_base_dir = Path(runs_base_dir)
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
    
    def translate_path(self, path: str) -> str:
        """Translate URL path to filesystem path."""
        path = path.split("?")[0].split("#")[0]
        path = path.lstrip("/")
        
        if path == "" or path == "index.html":
            return str(self._assets_dir / "index.html")
        elif path in ("dashboard.json", "timeseries.jsonl", "top_lemmas.json", "top_macros.json", "events.jsonl"):
            return str(self._run_dir / path)
        else:
            asset_path = self._assets_dir / path
            if asset_path.exists():
                return str(asset_path)
            return str(self._run_dir / path)
    
    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        """Handle GET request."""
        path = self.path.split("?")[0]
        
        # API endpoints
        if path == "/api/runs":
            self._handle_list_runs()
            return
        elif path == "/api/status":
            self._handle_status()
            return
        elif path == "/api/config":
            self._handle_config()
            return
        
        # Static files
        file_path = self.translate_path(self.path)
        
        if not os.path.exists(file_path):
            # Return empty content for data files that don't exist yet
            if path.endswith(".jsonl"):
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-type", "application/x-ndjson")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
                self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b"")
                return
            elif path.endswith(".json") and path.lstrip("/") in ("top_lemmas.json", "top_macros.json"):
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
                self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(b"[]")
                return
            
            self.send_response(404)
            self.send_header("Content-type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"File not found")
            return
        
        if file_path.endswith(".html"):
            content_type = "text/html"
        elif file_path.endswith(".json"):
            content_type = "application/json"
        elif file_path.endswith(".jsonl"):
            content_type = "application/x-ndjson"
        elif file_path.endswith(".js"):
            content_type = "application/javascript"
        elif file_path.endswith(".css"):
            content_type = "text/css"
        else:
            content_type = "application/octet-stream"
        
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
        self.end_headers()
        
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            self.wfile.write(f.read())
    
    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        """Handle POST request."""
        path = self.path.split("?")[0]
        
        # Read body
        content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(content_length).decode("utf-8") if content_length > 0 else "{}"
        
        try:
            data = json.loads(body) if body else {}
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            data = {}
        
        if path == "/api/stop":
            self._handle_stop()
        elif path == "/api/start":
            self._handle_start(data)
        elif path == "/api/resume":
            self._handle_resume(data)
        elif path == "/api/switch":
            self._handle_switch(data)
        else:
            self._send_json({"error": "Unknown endpoint"}, status=404)
    
    def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
        """Handle CORS preflight."""
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()
    
    def _send_json(self, data: Any, status: int = 200) -> None:
        """Send JSON response."""
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8"))
    
    def _handle_list_runs(self) -> None:
        """List all available runs."""
        runs = []
        
        if self._runs_base_dir.exists():
            for run_path in sorted(self._runs_base_dir.iterdir()):
                if run_path.is_dir():
                    run_info = {
                        "id": run_path.name,
                        "path": str(run_path),
                        "has_state": (run_path / "state.json").exists(),
                        "has_dashboard": (run_path / "dashboard.json").exists(),
                    }
                    
                    # Try to get summary stats
                    dashboard_path = run_path / "dashboard.json"
                    if dashboard_path.exists():
                        try:
                            with dashboard_path.open() as f:
                                dashboard = json.load(f)
                            run_info["generation"] = dashboard.get("generation", 0)
                            run_info["total_solved"] = dashboard.get("total_solved", 0)
                            run_info["total_attempts"] = dashboard.get("total_attempts", 0)
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    
                    # Check if running
                    pid_path = run_path / "selfplay.pid"
                    if pid_path.exists():
                        try:
                            pid = int(pid_path.read_text().strip())
                            # Check if process is alive
                            os.kill(pid, 0)
                            run_info["running"] = True
                            run_info["pid"] = pid
                        except (ValueError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                            run_info["running"] = False
                    else:
                        run_info["running"] = False
                    
                    runs.append(run_info)
        
        self._send_json({"runs": runs, "current": self._run_dir.name})
    
    def _handle_status(self) -> None:
        """Get current run status."""
        status = {
            "run_id": self._run_dir.name,
            "run_path": str(self._run_dir),
            "running": False,
            "pid": None,
        }
        
        pid_path = self._run_dir / "selfplay.pid"
        if pid_path.exists():
            try:
                pid = int(pid_path.read_text().strip())
                os.kill(pid, 0)  # Check if alive
                status["running"] = True
                status["pid"] = pid
            except (ValueError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                status["running"] = False
        
        # Get dashboard stats if available
        dashboard_path = self._run_dir / "dashboard.json"
        if dashboard_path.exists():
            try:
                with dashboard_path.open() as f:
                    dashboard = json.load(f)
                status["generation"] = dashboard.get("generation", 0)
                status["total_solved"] = dashboard.get("total_solved", 0)
                status["total_attempts"] = dashboard.get("total_attempts", 0)
                status["solve_rate"] = dashboard.get("solve_rate", 0)
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        self._send_json(status)
    
    def _handle_config(self) -> None:
        """Get default config for starting runs."""
        config = {
            "repo_url": "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4",
            "commit": "20c73142afa995ac9c8fb80a9bb585a55ca38308",
            "tasks_jsonl": ".cache/alphaproofpp/tasksets/nat50_v2/tasks_all.jsonl",
            "proof_corpus_dir": ".cache/alphaproofpp/selfplay/corpus/nat/proof_corpus.json",
            "premise_index_dir": ".cache/alphaproofpp/premises/index-mathlib-nat-all",
            "expert_index_dir": ".cache/alphaproofpp/selfplay/teacher_index/nat",
            "generations": 999999,
            "attempts_per_gen": 200,
            "workers": 2,
            "attempt_timeout_sec": 90,
            "max_simulations": 200,
            "max_depth": 12,
            "macro_max": 20000,
            "device": "mps",
        }
        self._send_json(config)
    
    def _handle_stop(self) -> None:
        """Stop the current run gracefully."""
        pid_path = self._run_dir / "selfplay.pid"
        
        if not pid_path.exists():
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": "No PID file found"})
            return
        
        try:
            pid = int(pid_path.read_text().strip())
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGINT)  # Graceful shutdown
            self._send_json({"success": True, "message": f"Sent SIGINT to PID {pid}"})
        except (ValueError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError) as e:
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": str(e)})
    
    def _handle_start(self, data: dict) -> None:
        """Start a new run."""
        run_id = data.get("run_id", f"run_{int(os.times().elapsed)}")
        new_run_dir = self._runs_base_dir / run_id
        new_run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Build command
        cmd = self._build_selfplay_command(new_run_dir, data, resume=False)
        
        # Start process
        try:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=open(new_run_dir / "selfplay.log", "w"),
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            
            # Save PID
            (new_run_dir / "selfplay.pid").write_text(str(proc.pid))
            
            self._send_json({
                "success": True,
                "run_id": run_id,
                "pid": proc.pid,
                "message": f"Started run {run_id}",
            })
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": str(e)})
    
    def _handle_resume(self, data: dict) -> None:
        """Resume an existing run."""
        run_id = data.get("run_id", self._run_dir.name)
        run_dir = self._runs_base_dir / run_id
        
        if not run_dir.exists():
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": f"Run {run_id} not found"})
            return
        
        # Check if already running
        pid_path = run_dir / "selfplay.pid"
        if pid_path.exists():
            try:
                pid = int(pid_path.read_text().strip())
                os.kill(pid, 0)
                self._send_json({"success": False, "error": f"Run {run_id} is already running (PID {pid})"})
                return
            except (ValueError, ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                pass
        
        # Build command
        cmd = self._build_selfplay_command(run_dir, data, resume=True)
        
        # Start process
        try:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                stdout=open(run_dir / "selfplay.log", "a"),
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            
            (run_dir / "selfplay.pid").write_text(str(proc.pid))
            
            self._send_json({
                "success": True,
                "run_id": run_id,
                "pid": proc.pid,
                "message": f"Resumed run {run_id}",
            })
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": str(e)})
    
    def _handle_switch(self, data: dict) -> None:
        """Switch to viewing a different run."""
        run_id = data.get("run_id")
        if not run_id:
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": "No run_id provided"})
            return
        
        new_run_dir = self._runs_base_dir / run_id
        if not new_run_dir.exists():
            self._send_json({"success": False, "error": f"Run {run_id} not found"})
            return
        
        # Update the run directory we're serving
        self._run_dir = new_run_dir
        self._send_json({"success": True, "run_id": run_id})
    
    def _build_selfplay_command(self, run_dir: Path, data: dict, resume: bool) -> list[str]:
        """Build the selfplay command."""
        cmd = [
            sys.executable, "-m", "alphaproofpp.cli.selfplay_run",
            "--run-dir", str(run_dir),
            "--repo-url", data.get("repo_url", "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4"),
            "--commit", data.get("commit", "20c73142afa995ac9c8fb80a9bb585a55ca38308"),
            "--tasks-jsonl", data.get("tasks_jsonl", ".cache/alphaproofpp/tasksets/nat50_v2/tasks_all.jsonl"),
            "--proof-corpus-dir", data.get("proof_corpus_dir", ".cache/alphaproofpp/selfplay/corpus/nat/proof_corpus.json"),
            "--premise-index-dir", data.get("premise_index_dir", ".cache/alphaproofpp/premises/index-mathlib-nat-all"),
            "--expert-index-dir", data.get("expert_index_dir", ".cache/alphaproofpp/selfplay/teacher_index/nat"),
            "--generations", str(data.get("generations", 999999)),
            "--attempts-per-gen", str(data.get("attempts_per_gen", 200)),
            "--workers", str(data.get("workers", 2)),
            "--attempt-timeout-sec", str(data.get("attempt_timeout_sec", 90)),
            "--max-simulations", str(data.get("max_simulations", 200)),
            "--max-depth", str(data.get("max_depth", 12)),
            "--macro-max", str(data.get("macro_max", 20000)),
            "--device", data.get("device", "mps"),
        ]
        
        if resume:
            cmd.append("--resume")
        
        return cmd
    
    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        """Log HTTP requests."""
        print(f"[HTTP] {args[0]} {args[1]} {args[2]}")


def run_server(run_dir: str, port: int = 8000) -> None:
    """Run the dashboard web server."""
    run_dir_path = Path(run_dir)
    if not run_dir_path.exists():
        run_dir_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Find assets directory
    assets_dir = Path(__file__).parent / "web_assets"
    if not assets_dir.exists():
        print(f"Error: Assets directory not found: {assets_dir}")
        return
    
    # Runs base directory (parent of run_dir)
    runs_base_dir = run_dir_path.parent
    
    print(f"Serving dashboard for: {run_dir}")
    print(f"Runs directory: {runs_base_dir}")
    print(f"Assets from: {assets_dir}")
    print(f"Open: http://localhost:{port}")
    
    handler = partial(
        DashboardHandler,
        run_dir=str(run_dir_path),
        assets_dir=str(assets_dir),
        runs_base_dir=str(runs_base_dir),
    )
    
    server = HTTPServer(("", port), handler)
    
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nServer stopped.")
    finally:
        server.server_close()


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Web server for self-play dashboard."
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--run-dir",
        required=True,
        help="Path to the run directory",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--port",
        type=int,
        default=8000,
        help="Port to listen on (default: 8000)",
    )
    return parser


def main() -> None:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    run_server(args.run_dir, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Actual proof attempt implementation.

This module contains the logic that runs inside the subprocess:
1. Open Dojo environment
2. Replay prefix tactics
3. Try macro fast-path (from macro library)
4. Fall back to MCTS search
5. Record results and compile new macros
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional

from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.types import GeneratedTask
from alphaproofpp.selfplay.worker.attempt_record import AttemptRecord


def attempt(
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    artifact_dir: str,
) -> AttemptRecord:
    """Run a proof attempt for a generated task.
    
    This function is called inside a subprocess and should handle
    all Dojo interaction, prefix replay, macro attempts, and search.
    
    Args:
        task: The generated task to attempt.
        cfg: Attempt configuration with keys:
            - max_simulations: Max MCTS simulations
            - max_depth: Max search depth
            - use_macros: Whether to try macro fast-path
            - write_traces: Whether to write proof traces
            - write_value_samples: Whether to write value samples
        artifact_dir: Directory to write artifacts.
    
    Returns:
        AttemptRecord with the attempt result.
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Initialize tracking variables
    llm_calls = 0
    verifier_attempted = 0
    verifier_misses = 0
    used_macro = False
    macro_id = None
    tactics: list[str] = []
    status = "timeout"  # Default to timeout, update on success/error
    error_message = None
    
    try:
        # Step 1: Open Dojo environment
        dojo, initial_state = _open_dojo(task)
        
        if dojo is None:
            # Dojo unavailable - return stub result
            return _make_stub_record(task, cfg, artifact_dir, start_time)
        
        # Step 2: Replay prefix tactics to reach start state
        current_state, prefix_ok = _replay_prefix(dojo, initial_state, task.prefix_tactics)
        
        if not prefix_ok:
            return AttemptRecord(
                task_id=task.task_id,
                theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
                file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
                status="error",
                error_message="Failed to replay prefix tactics",
                wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
                difficulty=task.difficulty,
                artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
                prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
            )
        
        # Get start state for potential macro compilation
        start_state_pp = _get_state_pp(current_state)
        
        # Step 3: Macro fast-path
        if cfg.get("use_macros", True):
            macro_result = _try_macro_fastpath(dojo, current_state, task, cfg)
            if macro_result is not None:
                tactics, macro_id, verifier_misses = macro_result
                used_macro = True
                status = "solved"
                verifier_attempted = len(tactics)
        
        # Step 4: Fall back to MCTS search if not solved by macro
        if status != "solved":
            search_result = _run_search(dojo, current_state, task, cfg)
            
            if search_result["solved"]:
                tactics = search_result["tactics"]
                status = "solved"
                
                # Compile macro from successful search (non-macro solve)
                if start_state_pp and cfg.get("compile_macros", True):
                    _compile_and_store_macro(
                        cfg,
                        start_state_pp,
                        tactics,
                        generation=task.difficulty.get("generation", 0),
                    )
            else:
                status = "timeout"
            
            llm_calls = search_result.get("llm_calls", 0)
            verifier_attempted = search_result.get("verifier_attempted", 0)
            verifier_misses = search_result.get("verifier_misses", 0)
        
        # Step 5: Write artifacts if solved
        if status == "solved" and cfg.get("write_traces", True):
            _write_proof_trace(artifact_dir, task, tactics, used_macro, macro_id)
        
        if status == "solved" and cfg.get("write_value_samples", True):
            _write_value_samples(artifact_dir, task, tactics)
        
        # Close Dojo
        _close_dojo(dojo)
        
    except Exception as e:
        status = "error"
        error_message = str(e)
    
    return AttemptRecord(
        task_id=task.task_id,
        theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
        status=status,
        used_macro=used_macro,
        macro_id=macro_id,
        steps=len(tactics),
        tactics=tactics,
        wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
        llm_calls=llm_calls,
        verifier_attempted=verifier_attempted,
        verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
        difficulty=task.difficulty,
        artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
        error_message=error_message,
        prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
    )


def _open_dojo(task: GeneratedTask) -> tuple[Any, Any] | tuple[None, None]:
    """Open a Dojo environment for the task.
    
    Args:
        task: The generated task.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (dojo, initial_state) or (None, None) if unavailable.
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.lean.dojo_env import DojoEnv
        from alphaproofpp.lean.spec import LeanTheoremSpec, RepoSpec
        
        # Create the theorem spec that DojoEnv expects
        spec = LeanTheoremSpec(
            repo=RepoSpec(
                url=task.theorem.repo_url,
                commit=task.theorem.commit,
            ),
            file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
            theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        )
        
        # DojoEnv is a context manager - enter it
        dojo = DojoEnv(spec)
        dojo.__enter__()
        initial_state = dojo.reset()
        return dojo, initial_state
    except ImportError as e:
        # LeanDojo not available
        print(f"[DOJO] ImportError: {e}")
        return None, None
    except Exception as e:
        # Failed to open Dojo
        print(f"[DOJO] Error: {e}")
        return None, None


def _close_dojo(dojo: Any) -> None:
    """Close a Dojo environment."""
    try:
        if hasattr(dojo, "close"):
            dojo.close()
    except Exception:
        pass


def _replay_prefix(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    prefix_tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
    """Replay prefix tactics to reach the starting state.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Initial state.
        prefix_tactics: List of tactics to replay.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (final_state, success).
    """
    current_state = state
    
    for tactic in prefix_tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None or (hasattr(result, "error") and result.error):
                return current_state, False
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            return current_state, False
    
    return current_state, True


def _try_macro_fastpath(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[list[str], str, int] | None:
    """Try to solve using a macro from the library.
    
    Looks up macros for the current state and tries the top K by utility.
    If a macro solves the goal, records success and returns early.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with:
            - macro_lib_path: Path to macro library JSON
            - macro_top_k: Number of macros to try (default 2)
            - search_budget_misses: Expected misses for full search
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (tactics, macro_id, verifier_misses) if successful, None otherwise.
    """
    macro_lib_path = cfg.get("macro_lib_path")
    if not macro_lib_path:
        return None
    
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import (
            state_key_from_pp,
            estimate_saved_misses,
        )
        
        # Load macro library
        macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(macro_lib_path)
        
        # Get state key from current state
        state_pp = _get_state_pp(state)
        if not state_pp:
            return None
        
        state_key = state_key_from_pp(state_pp)
        
        # Lookup macros for this state
        macro_hits = macro_lib.lookup(state_key)
        if not macro_hits:
            return None
        
        # Try top K macros
        top_k = cfg.get("macro_top_k", 2)
        search_budget_misses = cfg.get("search_budget_misses", 50)
        
        for macro in macro_hits[:top_k]:
            success, verifier_misses = _try_macro_tactics(dojo, state, macro.tactics)
            
            if success:
                # Record success
                saved_misses = estimate_saved_misses(search_budget_misses, verifier_misses)
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=True,
                    steps=len(macro.tactics),
                    verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
                    saved_misses_est=saved_misses,
                )
                # Save updated library
                macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
                return (macro.tactics, macro.macro_id, verifier_misses)
            else:
                # Record failure
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=False,
                )
        
        # No macro worked - save updated failure stats
        macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
        return None
        
    except Exception:
        return None


def _try_macro_tactics(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """Try applying a sequence of tactics.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state.
        tactics: List of tactics to apply.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (success, verifier_misses).
    """
    current_state = state
    verifier_misses = 0
    
    for tactic in tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            if hasattr(result, "error") and result.error:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            verifier_misses += 1
            return (False, verifier_misses)
    
    # Check if proof is complete
    if _is_proof_complete(current_state):
        return (True, verifier_misses)
    
    return (False, verifier_misses)


def _get_state_pp(state: Any) -> str | None:
    """Get pretty-printed state string.
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        Pretty-printed state string or None.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "pp"):
            return str(state.pp)
        if hasattr(state, "pretty_print"):
            return state.pretty_print()
        return str(state)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _is_proof_complete(state: Any) -> bool:
    """Check if proof is complete (no more goals).
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        True if proof is complete.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "goals"):
            return len(state.goals) == 0
        if hasattr(state, "is_complete"):
            return state.is_complete()
        return False
    except Exception:
        return False


def _run_search(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run MCTS search to find a proof.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with max_simulations, max_depth.
    
    Returns:
        Dict with:
            - solved: bool
            - tactics: list[str] if solved
            - llm_calls: int
            - verifier_attempted: int
            - verifier_misses: int
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.prover.mcts import MCTSConfig, mcts_solve
        
        mcts_cfg = MCTSConfig(
            max_simulations=cfg.get("max_simulations", 100),
            max_depth=cfg.get("max_depth", 8),
        )
        
        result = mcts_solve(dojo, state, mcts_cfg)
        
        return {
            "solved": result.get("status") == "solved",
            "tactics": result.get("tactics", []),
            "llm_calls": result.get("llm_calls", 0),
            "verifier_attempted": result.get("verifier_attempted", 0),
            "verifier_misses": result.get("verifier_misses", 0),
        }
    except ImportError:
        # MCTS not available
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }


def _write_proof_trace(
    artifact_dir: str,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    tactics: list[str],
    used_macro: bool,
    macro_id: str | None,
) -> None:
    """Write proof trace to artifact directory.
    
    Args:
        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.
        task: The task that was solved.
        tactics: Proof tactics.
        used_macro: Whether macro was used.
        macro_id: ID of macro if used.
    """
    trace = {
        "task_id": task.task_id,
        "theorem_name": task.theorem.theorem_name,
        "prefix_tactics": task.prefix_tactics,
        "proof_tactics": tactics,
        "full_proof": task.prefix_tactics + tactics,
        "used_macro": used_macro,
        "macro_id": macro_id,
        "difficulty": task.difficulty,
    }
    
    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "proof_trace.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)

    artifact_dir: str,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    tactics: list[str],
) -> None:
    """Write value samples for solved proof.
    
    Args:
        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.
        task: The task that was solved.
        tactics: Proof tactics.
    """

def _compile_and_store_macro(
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    start_pp: str,
    tactics: list[str],
    generation: int,
) -> None:
    """Compile and store a macro from a successful search.
    
    Called after a non-macro solve to grow the macro library.
    
    Args:
        cfg: Configuration with macro_lib_path.
        start_pp: Pretty-printed starting state.
        tactics: List of tactics that solved the goal.
        generation: Current generation number.
    """
    macro_lib_path = cfg.get("macro_lib_path")
    if not macro_lib_path:
        return
    
    # Skip very long tactic sequences (not useful as macros)
    max_macro_len = cfg.get("max_macro_len", 6)
    if len(tactics) > max_macro_len:
        return
    
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import state_key_from_pp
        
        # Load library
        macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(macro_lib_path)
        
        # Compute state key
        state_key = state_key_from_pp(start_pp)
        
        # Add or update macro
        macro_lib.add_or_update(state_key, tactics, generation)
        
        # Save updated library
        macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
        
    except Exception:
        pass  # Don't fail the attempt if macro compilation fails

) -> AttemptRecord:

        wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
        difficulty=task.difficulty,
        artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
        prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
    )
```

```python
"""Actual proof attempt implementation.

This module contains the logic that runs inside the subprocess:
1. Open Dojo environment
2. Replay prefix tactics
3. Try macro fast-path (from macro library)
4. Fall back to MCTS search
5. Record results and compile new macros
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Optional

from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.types import GeneratedTask
from alphaproofpp.selfplay.worker.attempt_record import AttemptRecord


def attempt(
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    artifact_dir: str,
) -> AttemptRecord:
    """Run a proof attempt for a generated task.
    
    This function is called inside a subprocess and should handle
    all Dojo interaction, prefix replay, macro attempts, and search.
    
    Args:
        task: The generated task to attempt.
        cfg: Attempt configuration with keys:
            - max_simulations: Max MCTS simulations
            - max_depth: Max search depth
            - use_macros: Whether to try macro fast-path
            - write_traces: Whether to write proof traces
            - write_value_samples: Whether to write value samples
        artifact_dir: Directory to write artifacts.
    
    Returns:
        AttemptRecord with the attempt result.
    """
    start_time = time.time()
    
    # Initialize tracking variables
    llm_calls = 0
    verifier_attempted = 0
    verifier_misses = 0
    used_macro = False
    macro_id = None
    tactics: list[str] = []
    status = "timeout"  # Default to timeout, update on success/error
    error_message = None
    
    try:
        # Step 1: Open Dojo environment
        dojo, initial_state = _open_dojo(task)
        
        if dojo is None:
            # Dojo unavailable - return stub result
            return _make_stub_record(task, cfg, artifact_dir, start_time)
        
        # Step 2: Replay prefix tactics to reach start state
        current_state, prefix_ok = _replay_prefix(dojo, initial_state, task.prefix_tactics)
        
        if not prefix_ok:
            return AttemptRecord(
                task_id=task.task_id,
                theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
                file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
                status="error",
                error_message="Failed to replay prefix tactics",
                wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
                difficulty=task.difficulty,
                artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
                prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
            )
        
        # Get start state for potential macro compilation
        start_state_pp = _get_state_pp(current_state)
        
        # Step 3: Macro fast-path
        if cfg.get("use_macros", True):
            macro_result = _try_macro_fastpath(dojo, current_state, task, cfg)
            if macro_result is not None:
                tactics, macro_id, verifier_misses = macro_result
                used_macro = True
                status = "solved"
                verifier_attempted = len(tactics)
        
        # Step 4: Fall back to MCTS search if not solved by macro
        if status != "solved":
            search_result = _run_search(dojo, current_state, task, cfg)
            
            if search_result["solved"]:
                tactics = search_result["tactics"]
                status = "solved"
                
                # Compile macro from successful search (non-macro solve)
                if start_state_pp and cfg.get("compile_macros", True):
                    _compile_and_store_macro(
                        cfg,
                        start_state_pp,
                        tactics,
                        generation=task.difficulty.get("generation", 0),
                    )
            else:
                status = "timeout"
            
            llm_calls = search_result.get("llm_calls", 0)
            verifier_attempted = search_result.get("verifier_attempted", 0)
            verifier_misses = search_result.get("verifier_misses", 0)
        
        # Step 5: Write artifacts if solved
        if status == "solved" and cfg.get("write_traces", True):
            _write_proof_trace(artifact_dir, task, tactics, used_macro, macro_id)
        
        if status == "solved" and cfg.get("write_value_samples", True):
            _write_value_samples(artifact_dir, task, tactics)
        
        # Close Dojo
        _close_dojo(dojo)
        
    except Exception as e:
        status = "error"
        error_message = str(e)
    
    return AttemptRecord(
        task_id=task.task_id,
        theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
        status=status,
        used_macro=used_macro,
        macro_id=macro_id,
        steps=len(tactics),
        tactics=tactics,
        wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
        llm_calls=llm_calls,
        verifier_attempted=verifier_attempted,
        verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
        difficulty=task.difficulty,
        artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
        error_message=error_message,
        prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
    )


def _open_dojo(task: GeneratedTask) -> tuple[Any, Any] | tuple[None, None]:
    """Open a Dojo environment for the task.
    
    Args:
        task: The generated task.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (dojo, initial_state) or (None, None) if unavailable.
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.lean.dojo_env import DojoEnv
        from alphaproofpp.lean.spec import LeanTheoremSpec, RepoSpec
        
        # Create the theorem spec that DojoEnv expects
        spec = LeanTheoremSpec(
            repo=RepoSpec(
                url=task.theorem.repo_url,
                commit=task.theorem.commit,
            ),
            file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
            theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        )
        
        # DojoEnv is a context manager - enter it
        dojo = DojoEnv(spec)
        dojo.__enter__()
        initial_state = dojo.reset()
        return dojo, initial_state
    except ImportError as e:
        # LeanDojo not available
        print(f"[DOJO] ImportError: {e}")
        return None, None
    except Exception as e:
        # Failed to open Dojo
        print(f"[DOJO] Error: {e}")
        return None, None


def _close_dojo(dojo: Any) -> None:
    """Close a Dojo environment."""
    try:
        # DojoEnv is a context manager, exit it properly
        dojo.__exit__(None, None, None)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _replay_prefix(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    prefix_tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
    """Replay prefix tactics to reach the starting state.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Initial state.
        prefix_tactics: List of tactics to replay.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (final_state, success).
    """
    current_state = state
    
    for tactic in prefix_tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None or (hasattr(result, "error") and result.error):
                return current_state, False
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            return current_state, False
    
    return current_state, True


def _try_macro_fastpath(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[list[str], str, int] | None:
    """Try to solve using a macro from the library.
    
    Looks up macros for the current state and tries the top K by utility.
    If a macro solves the goal, records success and returns early.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with:
            - macro_lib_path: Path to macro library JSON
            - macro_top_k: Number of macros to try (default 2)
            - search_budget_misses: Expected misses for full search
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (tactics, macro_id, verifier_misses) if successful, None otherwise.
    """
    macro_lib_path = cfg.get("macro_lib_path")
    if not macro_lib_path:
        return None
    
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import (
            state_key_from_pp,
            estimate_saved_misses,
        )
        
        # Load macro library
        macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(macro_lib_path)
        
        # Get state key from current state
        state_pp = _get_state_pp(state)
        if not state_pp:
            return None
        
        state_key = state_key_from_pp(state_pp)
        
        # Lookup macros for this state
        macro_hits = macro_lib.lookup(state_key)
        if not macro_hits:
            return None
        
        # Try top K macros
        top_k = cfg.get("macro_top_k", 2)
        search_budget_misses = cfg.get("search_budget_misses", 50)
        
        for macro in macro_hits[:top_k]:
            success, verifier_misses = _try_macro_tactics(dojo, state, macro.tactics)
            
            if success:
                # Record success
                saved_misses = estimate_saved_misses(search_budget_misses, verifier_misses)
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=True,
                    steps=len(macro.tactics),
                    verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
                    saved_misses_est=saved_misses,
                )
                # Save updated library
                macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
                return (macro.tactics, macro.macro_id, verifier_misses)
            else:
                # Record failure
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=False,
                )
        
        # No macro worked - save updated failure stats
        macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
        return None
        
    except Exception:
        return None


def _try_macro_tactics(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """Try applying a sequence of tactics.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state.
        tactics: List of tactics to apply.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (success, verifier_misses).
    """
    current_state = state
    verifier_misses = 0
    
    for tactic in tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            if hasattr(result, "error") and result.error:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            verifier_misses += 1
            return (False, verifier_misses)
    
    # Check if proof is complete
    if _is_proof_complete(current_state):
        return (True, verifier_misses)
    
    return (False, verifier_misses)


def _get_state_pp(state: Any) -> str | None:
    """Get pretty-printed state string.
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        Pretty-printed state string or None.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "pp"):
            return str(state.pp)
        if hasattr(state, "pretty_print"):
            return state.pretty_print()
        return str(state)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _is_proof_complete(state: Any) -> bool:
    """Check if proof is complete (no more goals).
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        True if proof is complete.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "goals"):
            return len(state.goals) == 0
        if hasattr(state, "is_complete"):
            return state.is_complete()
        return False
    except Exception:
        return False


def _run_search(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run MCTS search to find a proof.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with max_simulations, max_depth.
    
    Returns:
        Dict with:
            - solved: bool
            - tactics: list[str] if solved
            - llm_calls: int
            - verifier_attempted: int
            - verifier_misses: int
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.prover.mcts import MCTSConfig, mcts_solve
        
        mcts_cfg = MCTSConfig(
            max_simulations=cfg.get("max_simulations", 100),
            max_depth=cfg.get("max_depth", 8),
        )
        
        result = mcts_solve(dojo, state, mcts_cfg)
        
        return {
            "solved": result.get("status") == "solved",
            "tactics": result.get("tactics", []),
            "llm_calls": result.get("llm_calls", 0),
            "verifier_attempted": result.get("verifier_attempted", 0),
            "verifier_misses": result.get("verifier_misses", 0),
        }
    except ImportError:
        # MCTS not available
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }


def _write_proof_trace(
    artifact_dir: str,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    tactics: list[str],
    used_macro: bool,
    macro_id: str | None,
) -> None:
    """Write proof trace to artifact directory.
    
    Args:
        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.
        task: The task that was solved.
        tactics: Proof tactics.
        used_macro: Whether macro was used.

        "prefix_tactics": task.prefix_tactics,
        "proof_tactics": tactics,
        "full_proof": task.prefix_tactics + tactics,
        "used_macro": used_macro,
        "macro_id": macro_id,
        "difficulty": task.difficulty,
    }
    
    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "proof_trace.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)


def _write_value_samples(
    artifact_dir: str,
    task: GeneratedTask,

    """Write value samples for solved proof.

        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.

        tactics: Proof tactics.
    """

    # Will be integrated with existing value sample logic
```

```python
    Args:
        task: The generated task.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (dojo, initial_state) or (None, None) if unavailable.
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.lean.dojo_env import DojoEnv
        from alphaproofpp.lean.spec import LeanTheoremSpec, LeanRepoSpec
        
        # Create the theorem spec that DojoEnv expects
        spec = LeanTheoremSpec(
            repo=LeanRepoSpec(
                url=task.theorem.repo_url,
                commit=task.theorem.commit,
            ),
            file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
            theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        )
        
        # DojoEnv is a context manager - enter it
        dojo = DojoEnv(spec)
        dojo.__enter__()
        initial_state = dojo.reset()
        return dojo, initial_state
    except ImportError as e:
        # LeanDojo not available
        print(f"[DOJO] ImportError: {e}")
        return None, None
    except Exception as e:
        # Failed to open Dojo
        print(f"[DOJO] Error: {e}")
        return None, None


def _close_dojo(dojo: Any) -> None:
    """Close a Dojo environment."""
    try:
        # DojoEnv is a context manager, exit it properly
        dojo.__exit__(None, None, None)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _replay_prefix(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    prefix_tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[Any, bool]:
    """Replay prefix tactics to reach the starting state.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Initial state.
        prefix_tactics: List of tactics to replay.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (final_state, success).
    """
    current_state = state
    
    for tactic in prefix_tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None or (hasattr(result, "error") and result.error):
                return current_state, False
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            return current_state, False
    
    return current_state, True


def _try_macro_fastpath(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[list[str], str, int] | None:
    """Try to solve using a macro from the library.
    
    Looks up macros for the current state and tries the top K by utility.
    If a macro solves the goal, records success and returns early.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with:
            - macro_lib_path: Path to macro library JSON
            - macro_top_k: Number of macros to try (default 2)
            - search_budget_misses: Expected misses for full search
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (tactics, macro_id, verifier_misses) if successful, None otherwise.
    """
    macro_lib_path = cfg.get("macro_lib_path")
    if not macro_lib_path:
        return None
    
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import (
            state_key_from_pp,
            estimate_saved_misses,
        )
        
        # Load macro library
        macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(macro_lib_path)
        
        # Get state key from current state
        state_pp = _get_state_pp(state)
        if not state_pp:
            return None
        
        state_key = state_key_from_pp(state_pp)
        
        # Lookup macros for this state
        macro_hits = macro_lib.lookup(state_key)
        if not macro_hits:
            return None
        
        # Try top K macros
        top_k = cfg.get("macro_top_k", 2)
        search_budget_misses = cfg.get("search_budget_misses", 50)
        
        for macro in macro_hits[:top_k]:
            success, verifier_misses = _try_macro_tactics(dojo, state, macro.tactics)
            
            if success:
                # Record success
                saved_misses = estimate_saved_misses(search_budget_misses, verifier_misses)
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=True,
                    steps=len(macro.tactics),
                    verifier_misses=verifier_misses,
                    saved_misses_est=saved_misses,
                )
                # Save updated library
                macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
                return (macro.tactics, macro.macro_id, verifier_misses)
            else:
                # Record failure
                macro_lib.record_result(
                    macro.macro_id,
                    success=False,
                )
        
        # No macro worked - save updated failure stats
        macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
        return None
        
    except Exception:
        return None


def _try_macro_tactics(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    tactics: list[str],
) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    """Try applying a sequence of tactics.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state.
        tactics: List of tactics to apply.
    
    Returns:
        Tuple of (success, verifier_misses).
    """
    current_state = state
    verifier_misses = 0
    
    for tactic in tactics:
        try:
            result = dojo.run_tactic(current_state, tactic)
            if result is None:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            if hasattr(result, "error") and result.error:
                verifier_misses += 1
                return (False, verifier_misses)
            current_state = result
        except Exception:
            verifier_misses += 1
            return (False, verifier_misses)
    
    # Check if proof is complete
    if _is_proof_complete(current_state):
        return (True, verifier_misses)
    
    return (False, verifier_misses)


def _get_state_pp(state: Any) -> str | None:
    """Get pretty-printed state string.
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        Pretty-printed state string or None.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "pp"):
            return str(state.pp)
        if hasattr(state, "pretty_print"):
            return state.pretty_print()
        return str(state)
    except Exception:
        return None


def _is_proof_complete(state: Any) -> bool:
    """Check if proof is complete (no more goals).
    
    Args:
        state: Dojo state object.
    
    Returns:
        True if proof is complete.
    """
    try:
        if hasattr(state, "goals"):
            return len(state.goals) == 0
        if hasattr(state, "is_complete"):
            return state.is_complete()
        return False
    except Exception:
        return False


def _run_search(
    dojo: Any,
    state: Any,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run MCTS search to find a proof.
    
    Args:
        dojo: The Dojo environment.
        state: Current state after prefix replay.
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration with max_simulations, max_depth.
    
    Returns:
        Dict with:
            - solved: bool
            - tactics: list[str] if solved
            - llm_calls: int
            - verifier_attempted: int
            - verifier_misses: int
    """
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.prover.mcts import MCTSConfig, mcts_solve
        
        mcts_cfg = MCTSConfig(
            max_simulations=cfg.get("max_simulations", 100),
            max_depth=cfg.get("max_depth", 8),
        )
        
        result = mcts_solve(dojo, state, mcts_cfg)
        
        return {
            "solved": result.get("status") == "solved",
            "tactics": result.get("tactics", []),
            "llm_calls": result.get("llm_calls", 0),
            "verifier_attempted": result.get("verifier_attempted", 0),
            "verifier_misses": result.get("verifier_misses", 0),
        }
    except ImportError:
        # MCTS not available
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }
    except Exception:
        return {
            "solved": False,
            "tactics": [],
            "llm_calls": 0,
            "verifier_attempted": 0,
            "verifier_misses": 0,
        }


def _write_proof_trace(
    artifact_dir: str,
    task: GeneratedTask,
    tactics: list[str],
    used_macro: bool,
    macro_id: str | None,
) -> None:
    """Write proof trace to artifact directory.
    
    Args:
        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.
        task: The task that was solved.
        tactics: Proof tactics.
        used_macro: Whether macro was used.
        macro_id: ID of macro if used.
    """
    trace = {
        "task_id": task.task_id,
        "theorem_name": task.theorem.theorem_name,
        "prefix_tactics": task.prefix_tactics,
        "proof_tactics": tactics,
        "full_proof": task.prefix_tactics + tactics,
        "used_macro": used_macro,
        "macro_id": macro_id,
        "difficulty": task.difficulty,
    }
    
    path = Path(artifact_dir) / "proof_trace.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)


def _write_value_samples(
    artifact_dir: str,

) -> None:
    """Write value samples for solved proof.
    
    Args:
        artifact_dir: Directory to write to.

    """

    # Will be integrated with existing value sample logic
    pass


def _compile_and_store_macro(
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    start_pp: str,
    tactics: list[str],
    generation: int,
) -> None:
    """Compile and store a macro from a successful search.
    
    Called after a non-macro solve to grow the macro library.
    
    Args:
        cfg: Configuration with macro_lib_path.
        start_pp: Pretty-printed starting state.
        tactics: List of tactics that solved the goal.
        generation: Current generation number.
    """
    macro_lib_path = cfg.get("macro_lib_path")
    if not macro_lib_path:
        return
    
    # Skip very long tactic sequences (not useful as macros)
    max_macro_len = cfg.get("max_macro_len", 6)
    if len(tactics) > max_macro_len:
        return
    
    try:
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import state_key_from_pp
        
        # Load library
        macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(macro_lib_path)
        
        # Compute state key
        state_key = state_key_from_pp(start_pp)
        
        # Add or update macro
        macro_lib.add_or_update(state_key, tactics, generation)
        
        # Save updated library
        macro_lib.save(macro_lib_path)
        
    except Exception:
        pass  # Don't fail the attempt if macro compilation fails


def _make_stub_record(
    task: GeneratedTask,
    cfg: dict[str, Any],
    artifact_dir: str,
    start_time: float,
) -> AttemptRecord:
    """Create a stub record when Dojo is unavailable.
    
    Used for testing without LeanDojo.
    
    Args:
        task: The generated task.
        cfg: Configuration.
        artifact_dir: Artifact directory.
        start_time: When attempt started.
    
    Returns:
        AttemptRecord with error status.
    """
    return AttemptRecord(
        task_id=task.task_id,
        theorem_name=task.theorem.theorem_name,
        file_path=task.theorem.file_path,
        status="error",
        error_message="Dojo environment unavailable",
        wall_time_sec=time.time() - start_time,
        difficulty=task.difficulty,
        artifact_dir=artifact_dir,
        prefix_len=len(task.prefix_tactics),
    )
```

```python
def _run_worker_task(task_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Worker function to run a single attempt.
    
    This runs in a subprocess via ProcessPoolExecutor.
    
    Args:
        task_data: Dict with task info and config.
    
    Returns:
        Dict with attempt result.
    """
    from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.types import GeneratedTask, TheoremSpec
    from alphaproofpp.selfplay.worker.attempt_record import AttemptRecord
    from alphaproofpp.selfplay.worker.run_attempt import run_attempt_in_subprocess
    
    # Reconstruct GeneratedTask from serialized data
    theorem = TheoremSpec(
        repo_url=task_data["theorem"]["repo_url"],
        commit=task_data["theorem"]["commit"],
        file_path=task_data["theorem"]["file_path"],
        theorem_name=task_data["theorem"]["theorem_name"],
    )
    
    task = GeneratedTask(
        task_id=task_data["task_id"],
        theorem=theorem,
        prefix_tactics=task_data["prefix_tactics"],
        teacher_tail=task_data.get("teacher_tail"),
        difficulty=task_data["difficulty"],
        origin=task_data["origin"],
    )
    
    cfg = task_data["cfg"]
    run_dir = task_data["run_dir"]
    generation = task_data["generation"]
    
    try:
        record = run_attempt_in_subprocess(task, cfg, run_dir, generation)
        return record.to_dict()
    except Exception as e:
        # Return error record
        return {
            "task_id": task.task_id,
            "theorem_name": theorem.theorem_name,
            "file_path": theorem.file_path,
            "status": "error",
            "error_message": str(e),
            "wall_time_sec": 0.0,
            "difficulty": task.difficulty,
            "prefix_len": len(task.prefix_tactics),
        }


class SelfPlayRunner:
    """Main self-play orchestrator.
    
    Manages the generation loop, checkpointing, and component integration.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
        """Initialize the runner.
        
        Args:
            args: Parsed command-line arguments.
        """
        self.args = args
        self.run_dir = Path(args.run_dir)
        self.run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Initialize components (lazy loaded)
        self._state = None
        self._logger = None
        self._curriculum = None
        self._generator = None
        self._macro_lib = None
        self._synapse_tracker = None
        
        # Seed
        if args.seed:
            self._seed = args.seed
        else:
            self._seed = hashlib.sha256(str(self.run_dir).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    
    def _init_components(self) -> None:
        """Initialize all components."""
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.obs.event_logger import EventLogger
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.run_state import (
            RunState,
            create_new_run_state,
            load_run_state,
            save_run_state,
        )
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.curriculum.controller import CurriculumController
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.curriculum.state_io import (
            load_curriculum_state,
            save_curriculum_state,
            get_curriculum_state_path,
        )
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_lib import MacroLibrary
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.synapses import SynapseTracker
        
        # Load or create run state
        if self.args.resume:
            self._state = load_run_state(self.run_dir)
        
        if self._state is None:
            self._state = create_new_run_state(self.run_dir, self._seed)
            save_run_state(self._state, self.run_dir)
        
        # Initialize event logger
        self._logger = EventLogger(str(self.run_dir))
        
        # Initialize curriculum controller
        self._curriculum = CurriculumController()
        if self.args.resume:
            curriculum_state = load_curriculum_state(
                get_curriculum_state_path(self.run_dir)
            )
            if curriculum_state:
                self._curriculum.load_state(curriculum_state)
        
        # Initialize macro library
        self._macro_lib = MacroLibrary()
        if self.args.resume and Path(self._state.macro_lib_path).exists():
            self._macro_lib = MacroLibrary.load(self._state.macro_lib_path)
        
        # Initialize synapse tracker
        self._synapse_tracker = SynapseTracker(self.run_dir)
        
        # Initialize generator (if proof corpus available)
        self._init_generator()
    
    def _init_generator(self) -> None:
        """Initialize the task generator."""
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.full_theorem_generator import FullTheoremGenerator
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.subgoal_generator import SubgoalTaskGenerator
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.proof_corpus import ProofCorpus
        
        # Load proof corpus if available
        proof_corpus = None
        if self.args.proof_corpus_dir and Path(self.args.proof_corpus_dir).exists():
            corpus_path = Path(self.args.proof_corpus_dir)
            # If directory, look for proof_corpus.json inside
            if corpus_path.is_dir():
                corpus_file = corpus_path / "proof_corpus.json"
                if corpus_file.exists():
                    proof_corpus = ProofCorpus.from_cache(str(corpus_file))
            else:
                # Direct file path
                proof_corpus = ProofCorpus.from_cache(str(corpus_path))
        
        # Create generators
        self._full_generator = FullTheoremGenerator.from_tasks_jsonl(
            tasks_jsonl=str(self.args.tasks_jsonl),
            proof_corpus=proof_corpus,
        )
        
        if proof_corpus:
            self._subgoal_generator = SubgoalTaskGenerator.from_tasks_jsonl(
                tasks_jsonl=str(self.args.tasks_jsonl),
                proof_corpus=proof_corpus,
            )
        else:
            self._subgoal_generator = None
    
    def _checkpoint(self) -> None:
        """Save checkpoint of all state."""
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.run_state import save_run_state
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.curriculum.state_io import (
            save_curriculum_state,
            get_curriculum_state_path,
        )
        
        # Save run state
        save_run_state(self._state, self.run_dir)
        
        # Save curriculum state
        save_curriculum_state(
            self._curriculum.get_state(),
            get_curriculum_state_path(self.run_dir),
        )
        
        # Save macro library
        self._macro_lib.save(self._state.macro_lib_path)
    
    def _sample_tasks(self, n: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Sample tasks for a generation.
        
        Args:
            n: Number of tasks to sample.
        
        Returns:
            List of task data dicts (serializable).
        """
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.generator.types import DifficultyRequest
        
        # Get difficulty request from curriculum
        request = self._curriculum.propose_request(
            seed=f"{self._seed}_{self._state.gen}"
        )
        
        tasks = []
        
        # Decide mode based on request weights
        mode_weights = request.mode_weights
        subgoal_weight = mode_weights.get("subgoal", 0.8)
        
        for i in range(n):
            # Decide mode for this task
            task_seed = f"{self._seed}_{self._state.gen}_{i}"
            rng = random.Random(task_seed)
            
            if self._subgoal_generator and rng.random() < subgoal_weight:
                # Subgoal mode
                task = self._subgoal_generator.sample(request, 1)
                if task:
                    task = task[0]
                else:
                    # Fallback to full theorem
                    task = self._full_generator.sample(request, 1)
                    task = task[0] if task else None
            else:
                # Full theorem mode
                task = self._full_generator.sample(request, 1)
                task = task[0] if task else None
            
            if task:
                # Serialize task for worker
                task_data = {
                    "task_id": task.task_id,
                    "theorem": {
                        "repo_url": task.theorem.repo_url,
                        "commit": task.theorem.commit,
                        "file_path": task.theorem.file_path,
                        "theorem_name": task.theorem.theorem_name,
                    },
                    "prefix_tactics": task.prefix_tactics,
                    "teacher_tail": task.teacher_tail,
                    "difficulty": task.difficulty,
                    "origin": task.origin,
                    "cfg": {
                        "timeout_sec": self.args.attempt_timeout_sec,
                        "max_simulations": self.args.max_simulations,
                        "max_depth": self.args.max_depth,
                        "use_macros": True,
                        "compile_macros": True,
                        "macro_lib_path": self._state.macro_lib_path,
                        "macro_top_k": 2,
                        "search_budget_misses": 50,
                        "write_traces": True,
                        "write_value_samples": True,
                    },
                    "run_dir": str(self.run_dir),
                    "generation": self._state.gen,
                }
                tasks.append(task_data)
        
        return tasks
    
    def _run_generation(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Run a single generation.
        
        Returns:
            Dict with generation metrics.
        """
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.worker.attempt_record import AttemptRecord
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.obs.metrics import compute_generation_metrics
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.compile_from_trace import compile_macro_from_trace
        from alphaproofpp.selfplay.macros.macro_match import state_key_from_pp
        
        gen = self._state.gen
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Starting generation...")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        
        # Sample tasks
        tasks = self._sample_tasks(self.args.attempts_per_gen)
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Sampled {len(tasks)} tasks")
        
        # Run tasks with worker pool
        results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Use ProcessPoolExecutor for parallelism
        # Note: For testing without Dojo, workers will return stub results
        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=self.args.workers) as executor:
            futures = {
                executor.submit(_run_worker_task, task): task
                for task in tasks
            }
            
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    result = future.result(timeout=self.args.attempt_timeout_sec + 30)
                    results.append(result)
                except Exception as e:
                    # Task failed
                    task = futures[future]
                    results.append({
                        "task_id": task["task_id"],
                        "theorem_name": task["theorem"]["theorem_name"],
                        "status": "error",
                        "error_message": str(e),
                    })
                
                # Check stop flag
                if _stop_flag:
                    print(f"[GEN {gen}] Stop flag set, waiting for remaining tasks...")
        
        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Completed {len(results)} attempts in {elapsed:.1f}s")
        
        # Convert results to AttemptRecords
        attempt_records = []
        for r in results:
            try:
                record = AttemptRecord(**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "error_message"})
                if "error_message" in r:
                    record.error_message = r["error_message"]
                attempt_records.append(record)
            except Exception:
                pass
        
        # Update curriculum with results
        for record in attempt_records:
            self._curriculum.update(record)
        
        # Track novel solves
        novel_solves = []
        for record in attempt_records:
            if record.status == "solved":
                is_novel = self._state.add_solved_theorem(record.theorem_name)
                if is_novel:
                    novel_solves.append(record)
                    self._logger.log_event("proof_found", {
                        "theorem_name": record.theorem_name,
                        "steps": record.steps,
                        "used_macro": record.used_macro,
                        "macro_id": record.macro_id,
                        "generation": gen,
                    })
        
        # Update macro library
        macro_successes = 0
        macro_saved_misses = 0.0
        for record in attempt_records:
            if record.status == "solved":
                if record.used_macro:
                    macro_successes += 1
                    # Estimate saved misses (macro vs full search)
                    saved = max(0, 50 - record.verifier_misses)
                    macro_saved_misses += saved
        
        # Prune macro library periodically
        if gen > 0 and gen % 10 == 0:
            pruned = self._macro_lib.prune_mdl(
                max_macros=self.args.macro_max,
                min_success_rate=self.args.macro_min_success_rate,
                min_attempts=self.args.macro_min_attempts,
            )
            if pruned > 0:
                print(f"[GEN {gen}] Pruned {pruned} macros")
        
        # Update synapse stats
        synapse_stats = self._synapse_tracker.update_from_attempts(
            attempt_records,
            self._logger,
        )
        
        # Compute generation metrics
        solved = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "solved")
        timeout = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "timeout")
        error = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("status") == "error")
        attempts = len(results)
        
        macro_hit_rate = macro_successes / solved if solved > 0 else 0.0
        
        # Get difficulty info from curriculum
        curriculum_stats = self._curriculum.get_stats_summary()
        difficulty_target = None
        current_bucket = self._curriculum.current_bucket
        if current_bucket:
            difficulty_target = (current_bucket.lo, current_bucket.hi)
        
        # Log generation row
        gen_row = {
            "generation": gen,
            "solved": solved,
            "timeout": timeout,
            "error": error,
            "attempts": attempts,
            "solve_rate": solved / attempts if attempts > 0 else 0.0,
            "macro_repo_size": len(self._macro_lib),
            "macro_hit_rate": macro_hit_rate,
            "macro_successes": macro_successes,
            "macro_saved_misses": macro_saved_misses,
            "mean_steps_solved": (
                sum(r.get("steps", 0) for r in results if r.get("status") == "solved") / solved
                if solved > 0 else None
            ),
            "difficulty_target": difficulty_target,
            "difficulty_mean": curriculum_stats.get("overall_solve_rate"),
            "novel_solves": len(novel_solves),
            "elapsed_sec": elapsed,
        }
        
        self._logger.log_generation_row(gen_row)
        
        # Update run state totals
        self._state.total_attempts += attempts
        self._state.total_solved += solved
        
        # Print summary
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Solved: {solved}/{attempts} ({solved/attempts*100:.1f}%)")
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Novel: {len(novel_solves)}, Macro hits: {macro_successes}")
        print(f"[GEN {gen}] Macro library size: {len(self._macro_lib)}")
        
        return gen_row
    
    def run(self) -> None:
        """Run the self-play loop."""
        global _stop_flag
        
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"Self-Play Runner")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        print(f"Run directory: {self.run_dir}")
        print(f"Tasks file: {self.args.tasks_jsonl}")
        print(f"Workers: {self.args.workers}")
        print(f"Attempts per gen: {self.args.attempts_per_gen}")
        print(f"Max generations: {self.args.generations}")
        print(f"Resume: {self.args.resume}")
        print(f"{'='*60}\n")
        
        # Initialize components
        print("Initializing components...")
        self._init_components()
        
        print(f"Starting from generation {self._state.gen}")
        print(f"Solved theorems seen: {len(self._state.solved_theorems_seen)}")
        print(f"Macro library size: {len(self._macro_lib)}")
        
        # Main generation loop
        try:
            while self._state.gen < self.args.generations and not _stop_flag:
                # Run generation
                self._run_generation()
                
                # Increment generation
                self._state.gen += 1
                
                # Checkpoint
                self._checkpoint()
                
                # Check stop flag
                if _stop_flag:
                    print("\n[SHUTDOWN] Stop flag set, exiting after checkpoint...")
                    break
        
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\n[SHUTDOWN] Keyboard interrupt, checkpointing...")
        
        finally:
            # Final checkpoint
            self._checkpoint()
            print(f"\n[DONE] Final state saved. Generation: {self._state.gen}")
            print(f"[DONE] Total solved: {self._state.total_solved}/{self._state.total_attempts}")


def main() -> None:
    """Main entry point."""
    # Register signal handlers for graceful shutdown
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _signal_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _signal_handler)
    
    args = _build_parser().parse_args()
    
    runner = SelfPlayRunner(args)
    runner.run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
